items.title: San Ysidro Health - Campo — Free Food Distribution
items.description: Feeding San Diego runs this free food distribution at San Ysidro Health - Campo (976 Sheridan Road, Campo). Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–4:30 PM. Appointments preferred, walk-ins accepted. Call 619-478-2384 ahead if you can — distributions often end early when supplies run out, and schedules change with holidays and weather. Source: Feeding San Diego.
